}","note":"The decoded path is validated, but the code still continues to use the same stack buffer for later appends when the path is accepted."},{"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/mongoose/mongoose.c","function":"uri_to_path2","line":2019,"var":"path + n","code":"mg_snprintf(path + n, path_size - n, \"/\" MG_HTTP_INDEX);","note":"For directory requests, the code appends an index filename into the same bounded buffer, creating a write sink whose remaining space depends on the attacker-controlled URI length."},{"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/mongoose/mongoose.c","function":"uri_to_path2","line":2024,"var":"path[n + 1 + strlen(MG_HTTP_INDEX)]","code":"path[n + 1 + strlen(MG_HTTP_INDEX)] = '\\0';","note":"If the appended name is gzipped, the code writes a terminator at an index derived from the prior path length, which is the suspected memory-safety sink when the path is near the buffer limit."}]
